system.description:
This jutsu does not cost chakra to maintain concentration on it. You enhance your weapon with chakra to extend its reach. For the duration, all Flail Weapons gain an additional rank of Reach. They also gain a +2 bonus on Disarm, Grapple and Trip attempts if they have the associated weapon property.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3. If cast at B-Rank or higher, they gain an additional rank of Reach.
